theme: An open day in St. Pete.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan, and the girls are around — a genuinely open day in Kenwood. The three Croatia bookings on the board are the one thing worth closing before they harden.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Dubrovnik night
needsAttention.detail: A Cavtat room for Sept 19 — the only night still open after the charter disembarks and before the 7:30am flight out of DBV. Mike assigned it on the board; overdue since Aug 23.

needsAttention.title: Close the St. Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: Two nights, Sept 20 and 21, between the TPA landing from Croatia and the Tuesday school pickup — the last gap before the Orlando villa.

needsAttention.title: Pin down the Croatia baggage
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy bags now if they are missing, before airport-counter fees kick in.

flagged.title: A new MyChart message
flagged.detail: MaineHealth left a secure message in MyChart; the note itself only lands inside the portal.

flagged.title: New account access to review
flagged.detail: Google logged fresh app grants and sign-ins today — OpenAI and Claude for Gmail among them. Worth a glance to confirm each was you.

flagged.title: Anna's sourdough this week
flagged.detail: The bread baker in Maine asked, asap, whether you want in on this week's Everyday sourdough.

inbox.noise: The rest is receipts (Apple, Curb), governance newsletters, and the usual promotions.

recipe.title: Salmon Baked in Foil
recipe.why: A light summer supper that lets peak-season fish and herbs carry the plate.

acts.line: The calendar is clear straight through the morning.
Nothing scheduled, so the afternoon holds whatever you give it.
You are settled in Kenwood for the stretch — a calm evening at home.
